note: UTE G1 per-family retirement ledger (revised 2026-11-20 after the external review). The four terms are the owner's predicate (RetireAllowed = OldBaseline AND NewPathVerified AND SemanticDifferencesResolved AND NegativeControlsPass). Three rules the gate enforces and this ledger cannot talk its way out of: (1) `unit.familyId` is resolved against dev/agent-workflow/ledgers/arc-a-family-census.json, so a row cannot shrink the retirement unit to the tools it happened to verify; (2) coverage is derived from the baseline TSV's `entry` column and the new path's `NEW-PATH-VECTOR <id>` lines, so a member with no vector is refused rather than absorbed; (3) every declared `oldPath.files` entry is checked for presence, and scripts/eb3-family-definitions.mjs turns required CI red (DEF_RETIREMENT_UNLICENSED) if one is deleted while the row is not allowed. `state` remains a mirror of the computed verdict. See docs/plans/memo/ute-g1-20261120/RETIREMENT.md.

differences.summary: A `grep` call WITHOUT `path` returns ZERO matches on the product route: the host module omits the path operand from argv and the confined child's fd 0 is a readable socket, so ripgrep searches stdin instead of the session workspace (the tool description says a missing path defaults to the workspace). The governed row always appends `.` and returns the real set. MEASURED both ways on one fixture (SD-PATHLESS in semantic-differences.txt) and recorded as the product behaviour in golden row SR-G2-no-path-stdin. APPROVAL: PENDING (owner signature required) — this is a measured defect, not a reinterpretation.

The two implementations select DIFFERENT file sets for the same pattern: the route-C confined face runs ripgrep with `--no-ignore-parent --no-ignore-vcs` (a VCS-ignored file IS searched), while the governed row adds `--no-ignore-parent --no-ignore-global` only (VCS ignore stays in force, so the same file is NOT searched). MEASURED: the observed route-C argv (read from the confined provider call record) vs `searchArgv()` from packages/tools/search-family/src/search-backend.mjs, both executed on one fixture; only-route-c = the .gitignore'd file. APPROVAL: PENDING (owner signature required).

A withheld search surfaces differently: on route C every confined denial produces the SAME model-facing text ('subprocess failed before reporting an outcome (ripgrep provider failure)') and the cause exists only as the realm's a5sf-guard-consult/1 fact (IO_READ_DENIED — the same code for a lane denial and a missing target), while the governed row owns a closed per-cause SEARCH_REFUSAL_TEXT vocabulary and no guard-fact channel. Both map onto the same closed category here, but a consumer keying on the model-facing error cannot distinguish the cases on route C. APPROVAL: PENDING (owner signature required).

differences.summary: ONE NATIVE NAME, TWO CLAIMANTS. The legacy governed family claims the FIXED native spellings web_fetch/web_search (packages/tools/families/web.mjs familyAssembly.claims(); opt-in webEnabled, ABSENT = FALSE, disabledOwned deliberately empty) while the product route-C composition ALSO serves both names (measured: the world registry + the corpus). An install with webEnabled:true therefore has two producers of the same two names and the seam names no winner. Retirement cannot move a name whose ownership is not yet single. MEASURED in probe-semantic-differences.mjs (SD-WEB-1 legacy.claims/enabled + route-c visible). APPROVAL: PENDING (owner signature required).

WHERE THE REDIRECT LAW LIVES. The legacy transport NEVER follows a redirect: it answers ONE bounded response (measured: /r1 -> HTTP 302, location /r2, ONE fixture arrival) and the governed row drives the chain under MAX_REDIRECT_HOPS=5. The route-C face hands the call to the pinned provider, which follows same-origin hops itself under its own maxRedirects, so ONE tool call produces THREE fixture arrivals (measured: /r1, /r2, /final) and the face discloses it as the ALLOW residual WEB_REDIRECT_UNMEDIATE_ON_ALLOW. The hop budget's owner and the number of network effects per call both move. APPROVAL: PENDING (owner signature required).

THE REFUSAL SURFACE. The legacy mechanics raise TYPED refusals (webRefusal(kind, code, detail), e.g. WEB_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE) so a governed consumer keys on a code. On route C the body/format/deadline refusals are the PINNED provider's WebErrors rendered as PROSE: measured on WB-F6/WB-F7/WB-F9 the model sees `Error: <prose>` with NO typed code and the guard fact for the same call says ALLOW (the call WAS admitted before the body was refused). This lane had to name those prose patterns in a closed table to classify three of its own rows. A consumer keying on a refusal code cannot distinguish a size/content-type/deadline refusal from a transport fault on route C. APPROVAL: PENDING (owner signature required).

negativeControlsPass.note: ELEVEN controls, one REAL control per retirement-unit member PLUS the family-level set. NC-MEMBER web_fetch widens ONLY the DECLARED destination set (extraTestEndpoints http://localhost:3182) around WB-F11: the refused out-of-lane call then succeeds and the fixture serves the body (providerFetches 1, loopback socket) while the pinned provider, the pinned SSRF policy and the byte cap are untouched. NC-MEMBER web_search widens ONLY the declared capability (searchMode present) around WB-S3: the availability refusal disappears because the provider's own available() is the decision. Each is paired with NC-MEMBER-POSITIVE, which re-runs the UNMODIFIED vectors and shows they still reproduce their golden rows. Family-level: NC-GOLDEN-MUTATION (a flipped status and an invented request hop turn the comparator RED on `effects`), NC-CATEGORY-TOTAL (an invented code raises REFUSAL_VOCABULARY_INCOMPLETE; `unknown` and `other` unreachable), NC-SHADOW-LOAD-BEARING (disposing the PD-27 web shadow makes the call reach the INHERITED host ctx.web and trip BL18_TRIPWIRE with ZERO fixture arrivals), NC-NET-SHIM-LOAD-BEARING (a disabled socket witness REFUSES to report a zero: NET_WITNESS_MISSING), NC-NET-COUNTER-POSITIVE (one non-loopback connect through the patched prototype moves the external counter to 1 and reaches the real connect ZERO times, so the zero in the golden run is a measurement and not a constant), NC-CONCURRENT-NORMALIZATION (the one concurrent vector declares its request witness sorted) and NC-GOLDEN-DESIGN-CLAIMS (all 15 golden rows satisfy their corpus claim). The lane suite re-runs the transcript and refuses any verdict line that is not GREEN with failed=0. A green WEB control is not evidence for FS, Search, PTY or any other family.
